verdict.rationale: Community anecdotes mention keyboard-driven launchers (Unity's HUD type-to-search, comm-3) and window-management hotkeys (WIN+SHIFT+arrow, comm-11), suggesting some keyboard-only workflows were possible, but these refer to the deprecated Unity/Compiz stack, not the current GNOME-based Ubuntu Desktop, and another comment (comm-15) calls window hiding/switching 'painful.' Missing for 10: first-party documentation of GNOME's keyboard shortcuts and Activities-overview launcher, a systematic keyboard-only workflow guide, and independent confirmation that today's Ubuntu supports full keyboard-only operation.
